per_pilot_archive.name: _per_pilot.zip
per_pilot_archive.content_relation: The 23 NPZ products and quarantine ledger are byte-identical to the previously audited pilot-proxy-runs.zip payload.

detector_kernel.name: libfstatistic-2.1.0-c85f50dd.so
detector_kernel.relation_to_products: The shared-object digest equals the kernel hash recorded in all 23 products.

survey_enumeration.pending_attempt_category_interpretation: Frozen source-inventory category after two recorded attempts; the three unprocessed units are the released quarantines, not an active retry queue.
survey_enumeration.catalogued_object_bytes_scope: Sum of object sizes in inventory.jsonl; not a measurement of bytes transferred during processing.

product_inventory.quarantine_reconciliation: 170377 inventory rows = 170374 product units + 3 explicit quarantine records.
product_inventory.cohort_compatibility: Both cohorts record the same kernel digest, detector geometry, and product schema.

health_filtered_exposure.status: partial because 2489 otherwise health-included frames lack a positive finite frame duration
released_coordinates: local mean sidereal hour at longitude -119.6175 degrees
health_filtered_exposure.sidereal_convention: UTC is used as a documented proxy for UT1; the result is local mean rather than apparent sidereal time and is a coverage diagnostic, not an astrometry product.

health_gate.policy: Fail closed on archived detector-invalid rows or on the exact representation-ceiling signature; retain an immutable reason-coded frame ledger.
health_gate.overlap_note: The four detector-invalid rows also have all-zero power fields; reason counts are not additive.
health_gate.scientific_status: Final for this archive release. The excluded values are mathematically inconsistent with a healthy sky measurement under the declared representation; raw files are not required to justify their exclusion.

explicit_invalid_population.observed_state: All target, reference, fine-statistic, and baseband-power fields are zero.

ceiling_power_population.representation_proof: Each native excess-8 complex-int4 component decodes to an integer in [-8,7], so per-sample power is at most (-8)^2+(-8)^2=128. A frame mean equal to that bound is possible only when every sample is (-8,-8).
ceiling_power_population.acquisition_root_cause: Unknown because the raw HDF5 objects and acquisition logs are not present; this uncertainty does not change the input-health disposition.

aggregate_spectrum_repair.basis: A constant detector-input byte 0x88 is the complex value (-8,-8). Its unshifted 16384-point FFT has power only at bin 0, so its contribution to each stored accumulator is known exactly.
aggregate_spectrum_repair.validation: Every repaired accumulator is nonnegative and agrees with the corresponding health-included frame-power sum within the declared Parseval tolerance.

fine_designation_population.status: Diagnostic survey scaffolding, not the mature per-channel fine decision.
fine_designation_population.recoverability: The complete 256-bin fstat_fine array is retained for every frame, so the broad geometry-predicted acquisition neighborhood, circular windows, empirical epoch anchors, and null bulk can be recomputed without rerunning CUDA.
fine_designation_population.released_archive_diagnostic: The v1 health release replaces the obsolete bin-zero view with a broad geometry-predicted +/-30 fine-bin acquisition neighborhood and, where declared persistence, separation, frame-count, and external-sentinel gates pass, a narrow retrospective quarterly measured-line +/-2 window. These are floating-point archive diagnostics, not authoritative station epochs or an exact Q16 runtime decision.
fine_designation_population.remaining_calibration_boundary: A final decision bundle must estimate or refuse a measured anchor independently for each declared epoch, record its uncertainty and circular-bin convention, construct the null bulk around that measured window, and validate the selected Q16 threshold on a blocked holdout.
fine_designation_population.exact_replay_limit: The archive stores float32 F ratios rather than the three uint64 fine-power accumulators, so an exact threshold-near Q16 replay of historical frames is unavailable without raw data.
fine_designation_population.release_rule: Do not use archived fine_cfar or fine_detected ancillary arrays as final calibrated decisions.

provenance_availability.disposition: Report the three recorded two-attempt events exactly. Report the remaining fields as unavailable. Do not substitute catalogued object bytes for transferred bytes or infer performance telemetry from products.

interpretation: The inventory, products, quarantines, and supplied kernel reconcile exactly. The v1 health gate closes the archive input-health release blocker and supports repaired relative spectra, scalar distributions, thresholds, rates, fine-F diagnostics, and downstream policy tables. It does not create raw-voltage spectrograms, absolute calibrated PSDs, or missing operational telemetry.
